headline.text: L3 ML1 fought depositing jams for *6 hours* — dousing head pulled, cleaned, reinstalled but line still working through it at window close

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 recovered a pin from the melting tank with a magnet in under 40 minutes and ran the rest of the shift. Sollich 4 ran out of bags and boxes for WIP packing at 08:15 and is using slip sheets and layer pads as a workaround.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 ran out of caramel mid-morning; new material arrived from L1 and the line restarted under quarantine status with written approval from Bequet. Three pallets on the grinding line are waiting for new work-order labels. A pallet jack failed and was locked out.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 had repeated depositing problems starting at 07:02 — Cavanna tearing film, air locks, right-side nozzle jams. Maintenance pulled and cleaned the dousing head; it was reinstalled and tested but the line was still troubleshooting at window close. ML4 cleared a scraper alignment issue in 44 minutes. Truffle line M3 belt alarmed at 09:55 and maintenance was called.

notes.text: MD safety covers were found removed on Sollich 3; Nathan Topham locked it out and will pass to next shift for proper LOTO procedure.
Materials for FFS restart staged at SE; level 1 requests submitted overnight for film and cases.
Truffle line conveyor handle is very loose after an operator's smock caught it; maintenance lubed the cylinder to close it but it needs tightening on the next clean.

resolved.title: Pin fell into Sollich 3 melting tank
resolved.summary: Latch knob disconnected and pin fell into AD1 melting tank during chocolate loading; pump shut off immediately, line speed reduced to 50 on one tank.
resolved.resolution: Pin recovered at 19:28 using a long magnet; line speed restored to 72. Total impact under 40 minutes.

resolved.title: AD2 melting tank latch pin rotated and stuck
resolved.summary: Pin on second melting tank rotated and jammed, preventing lid closure and stirrer function on Sollich 3.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance freed the pin by 19:32; line speed increased back to 72.

resolved.title: MF Matrix depositing cone fell off
resolved.summary: Cone detached from MF Matrix line at 13:44; line stopped, maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Line restarted at 14:10 after maintenance repair. Down 26 minutes.

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt tracking issue after tension adjustment
resolved.summary: Maintenance adjusted C6 belt tension at 05:11, which caused tracking problems; line stopped.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:37 — "line is back up and running" (Imperial). Down 26 minutes.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 scrapers installed in wrong position
resolved.summary: Scrapers rubbing rollers and causing metal dust; line down, Kavin Ayala working on it.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 08:15 — "This was fixed at 8:15, TG5 is now running" (Itzel Chavez). Down 44 minutes.

resolved.title: ML1 buffer tank temp below normal
resolved.summary: Buffer tank temperature dropped below target; maintenance was notified and responded.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:38 — "Maintenance has gotten the temp back to normal on the buffer tank" (Imperial).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 out of bags and boxes for WIP packing
needs_attention.summary: Line ran out of correct bags (41264) and boxes for packing HER WIP candy at 08:15; approximately 2,940 bags used in prior 24 hours.
needs_attention.status: Using slip sheets top and bottom of pallets for protection and layer pads per QA request as temporary workaround; Curt Willis asked for usage math at 08:52.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 MD safety covers removed improperly
needs_attention.summary: Machine operator or lead removed safety covers from the MD without following lockout/tagout procedure; screws were missing.
needs_attention.status: Nathan locked out the MD and secured screws by supervisor binder; will pass to next shift for proper LOTO. Chris Jeffs reminded that only maintenance should remove/install covers.

needs_attention.title: Pallet jack not working
needs_attention.summary: Electric pallet jack charged but will not move forward or backward; not a safety risk but operationally down.
needs_attention.status: Alan Todd locked it out with key at 16:47 on 9/3 to prevent use; requested HOJ service but no update in window.

needs_attention.title: Grinding line pallets waiting for new work-order labels
needs_attention.summary: Three pallets of ground product completed but need new WO created for date change before labels can be applied.
needs_attention.status: Pallets still waiting as of 06:12; Gustavo Rodas, Nidia Lopez, Sofia Carcamo, and Joey Dudney tagged.

needs_attention.title: ML1 depositing stopped, repeated jams and flow-wrap tears
needs_attention.summary: Cavanna stopping frequently at 11 MPM due to flow wrap tearing starting at 07:02; alarm triggered at 07:25, air lock cleared at 07:44; right-side depositing stopped again at 08:20, hopper jammed.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance removed dousing head at 09:34, cleaned it, reinstalled and tested by 10:24. Waiting for hopper temp to drop before filling. Line still troubleshooting at window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 PTL2 not working in auto mode
needs_attention.summary: PTL2 running in manual only; Nelson Cook working on getting auto mode restored.
needs_attention.status: Nelson still working on it as of 07:40; no resolution by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M3 belt alarm triggered
needs_attention.summary: M3 belt alarm activated at 09:55; maintenance has been called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 09:55; no update on arrival or resolution by window close.
